text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Cute and Hardworking Tracen Girls Feature☆"...
You wish to feature me in this article?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Lately, your valiant efforts on the racetrack
have been attracting a lot of attention, Ikuno-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That is... quite an honor to hear, however—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if I am truly capable of the conduct
expected for a teens' magazine...)

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, my own daughter looks up
to you, Ikuno-san! She says seeing you build up
effort and seize victory is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Your daughter does?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And not just my daughter, either.
There are more and more posts on social media
saying you've given them courage!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To think that I could be an inspiration
who provides courage to others...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I would be glad to accept!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—I see! So you'd like to learn all about
cuteness from Karen and Fine-chan, right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Out of the numerous students enrolled here,
they chose me... I wish to live up to their
expectations without fail.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Karen-san, known as the "Evangelist of Cuteness,"
and Fine-san, widely beloved in Ireland—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I concluded that no one could be better suited
to teach me than the two of you, which is why
I sought your counsel today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'd be happy to help, if you'll have me!
Though, what should I teach about being cute, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see~... How about we start by showing you
what Karen and Fine-chan "usually do"?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#CuteSpot #At"
"#ResearchingCuteness #With #Ikuno-san☆"
...And posted♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the rainbow parfait looks great,
but maybe the new animal crepe would pop
better for a photo together?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. Considering color palette, shape, buzz factor...
Factoring multiple variables to derive
optimal visual appeal—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
These are all animals we don't have back in Ireland...
Fufu. Good day to you all, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Never letting a gentle smile fade,
regardless of who the subject may be—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Over here, over here~♪
Shall the three of us take a photo with the flower garden as the backdrop?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Calculating optimal aesthetics, maintaining a smile at all times.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I analyzed cuteness and attempted to put it
into practice in my own way, but...
it feels somewhat awkward.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From your perspectives, if there are any
strange habits or points of improvement,
I would appreciate your feedback—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Could it be that you haven't realized,
Ikuno-san?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Karen has already received your brand of cuteness
loud and clear♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Cuteness is a dialogue of feelings.
When cute connects with cute, the whole world
gets filled with cuteness♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you study cuteness with all your heart
conveyed the absolute best kind of cute—
and it made Karen's heart feel even cuter too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Watching you give it your all, Ikuno-chan,
felt wonderfully charming and sweet to me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Every girl has her own unique charm...
I think your own version of "cute"
is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Both of you...

And a few days later, Ikuno Dictus
headed into the magazine interview—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The cute and hardworking Ikuno-san shows off
the fruits of her research to the fullest,
even in her heart pose—" It says!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, it's trending on Umatter♪
Your cuteness reached everyone loud and clear,
Ikuno-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I poured everything I had into it,
so I am relieved to see it well-received.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Karen-san, Fine-san.
Cuteness is... delightful,
and brings quite a sense of joy, doesn't it?
